🏒 Dynamic Proximity Roles (Sorted by Distance to Puck)

F1 • F2 • F3 • D1 • D2

In hockey, F1 / F2 / F3 and D1 / D2 are based on who is closest to the puck right now—not fixed lineup positions (LW/C/RW). Whenever the puck moves, roles swap automatically!

F1 — First Forward (Closest)
Closest forward to puck. Angles the puck carrier with stick-on-puck to force a rushed play.
F2 — Second Forward (Support)
2nd-closest forward. Reads the angling lane, seals the wall outlet, and jumps on turnovers.
F3 — Third Forward (High Slot)
Furthest forward from puck. Holds high in the slot as the safety valve against odd-man rushes.
D1 (Challenge) & D2 (House)
Closest D challenges corner/wall; Furthest D stays central to Protect the House.
